cues: When unpolarized light strikes glass or water, both the reflected and the refracted beams come out partly polarized.
Its arrow component, vibrating in the plane of incidence, shrinks as we change the angle.
text: When unpolarized light strikes glass or water, both the reflected and the refracted beams come out partly polarized. Watch the reflected beam. Its arrow component, vibrating in the plane of incidence, shrinks as we change the angle.
